name: Trance of the Thousand Faces (Bad Eden)

system.source: Bad Eden Originals — Sprint F (2026 rules)

description.value:
"Identity is negotiable."

Mode: Shape-changer

The Thousand Faces is never quite where — or who — you swung at. Your Surge spends weaponize misdirection: borrowed faces that can't be hit cleanly, read tells thrown back at the enemy, two of you at once.

Trance (spent via Surge)

  • Borrowed Face (1) — they can't tell which face is real: you gain DR + bank a reroll.
  • Mirror Read (2) — you wear a foe's tell back at them: it rolls its next attack rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2, and you bank a reroll.
  • Shared Face (3) — you and an ally blur behind borrowed identities: both gain DR.

Out-of-combat: Mirror Read, Persona Cache, Borrowed Voice, Mask of Accord, Crowd Current and Thousandfold Echo remain the strategic flourishes.
